resources.string: Go to settings, setup an remote endpoint for the call log and enable sync.
Synced %1$d entries from the call log.
Sync: no new entries in the call log.
Learn to setup a remote endpoint
Invalid remote endpoint. Must start with http(s)://
Sending random call log to remote endpoint
Send random call log to remote endpoint
All settings are locked and can no longer be changed. Only a reset is still possible.
This will reset all sync settings to their initial values. New device token will be generated.
Are you sure you want to reset all sync settings?
Please disable "Pause app activity if unused".

CallTrack development slice. Choose a calendar, then explicitly log the latest call. Automatic logging starts only after you explicitly enable it in Automatic logging settings. Calendar providers may sync saved events to their accounts.
Calendar and call-log access are required for this action.
No visible writable calendars are available. Configure one in your calendar app, then refresh.
Choose a calendar before logging a call.
The calendar is unavailable. Refresh and choose a destination; no fallback calendar is used.
If access was granted, tap Log latest call again for this manual action. Any previously enabled automatic policy can resume when access returns.
Event saved and read back successfully.
This call is already logged in this calendar.
Recovered an existing event without creating a duplicate.
An existing event or source has changed. Review is required; no existing event was overwritten.
The call contains invalid time or duration data.
The operation could not be verified. Retry can reconcile an existing event; check the calendar before further action.

Choose a calendar and call types, then enable logging from now. Draft changes do not alter an active policy until applied. Calls during a pause require a historical import. Calendar providers may sync events to their accounts. Phone-state access supports prompt call-end wakeups; periodic recovery still works without it.

Start a new logging period from now with the selected calendar and call types? Existing calendar events remain unchanged. Earlier calls and paused work are not imported by enabling. Android can delay background work; reopen this screen to request recovery.
Automatic logging paused or not enabled.
Across all destinations — pending: %1$d; previously verified: %2$d; review: %3$d; suppressed: %4$d. Previously verified events may have since changed or been deleted.
The action could not be verified. Refresh status before retrying; existing events were not moved or deleted.
Settings saved. Background delivery is separate; refresh status to check the latest result.
No completed background attempt is recorded for this logging period.
Last background attempt finished its bounded scan. This does not confirm cloud synchronisation.
Last background attempt stopped because it was paused or no longer current.
More pending work remains; recovery has been requested.
Last background attempt failed. Pending receipts remain available for recovery.
Recorded failed background attempts in this logging period: %1$d. Earlier attempts may be unavailable. This is not a count of failed calls.
The latest attempt status is unavailable. Refresh or request recovery.

Preview a historical range before importing. Dates use %1$s and YYYY-MM-DD format. The end date is excluded. Previewing never writes calendar events. Closing or stopping a run leaves its saved session available to resume.

Import the frozen set of %1$d calls into %2$s? Range: %3$s. Current call data is checked before writing. Existing edited or deleted events are not recreated automatically. Some items may require review.
Stopping at the next safe boundary. The session remains available to resume.
Cancel all remaining work in this session? Current effects are preserved. A cancelled session cannot resume; use a new preview if needed.
Enter valid YYYY-MM-DD dates with an exclusive end after the start. Dates must exist in the selected timezone and be on or after the supported epoch.
Create another preview? The previous session stays saved and stopped. You can select it from the saved sessions list.
The run stopped and its result was saved. Check permissions, destination availability and review items before continuing. Progress was not guessed.

Destination: %3$s
Call types: %4$s
Candidates: %5$d; verified: %6$d; review: %7$d. Verified includes existing events checked during this import.
Source changed — create a new preview
No saved sessions on this page.
This action could not be verified. Saved session progress and delivery receipts remain available. Refresh by selecting the saved session before retrying.
